query:
-- First, get the project ID
SET @project_id = (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE slug = 'red-bull-jukebox');

-- Delete one of the duplicate Brothers Osborne production photos (keep ID 60035, delete 60036)
DELETE FROM project_images WHERE id = 60036;

-- Update image type from 'rendering' to 'technical_drawing' for CNC drafting plates
UPDATE project_images 
SET imageType = 'technical_drawing',
    altText = REPLACE(altText, 'Scenic design', 'CNC fabrication drawings')
WHERE projectId = @project_id AND imageType = 'rendering';

-- Add new production photos
INSERT INTO project_images (projectId, imageUrl, imageType, altText, sortOrder)
VALUES
  (@project_id, 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/EMKaXlsnQrfQeNdH.jpg', 'production', 'Red Bull Jukebox Nashville 2024 - Wide view of LED arch installation and stage design by Brandon PT Davis with Lumenati', 1),
  (@project_id, 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/IQqdmHGQMUxwfNpA.jpg', 'production', 'Red Bull Jukebox Nashville 2024 - Full venue view showing monumental LED arch and crowd at Ascend Amphitheater', 2),
  (@project_id, 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/tWnsoIGIldylcfSL.jpg', 'production', 'Red Bull Jukebox Nashville 2024 - Close-up of LED arch with Red Bull Jukebox branding and stage lighting', 3);
